## Language package and header fixes

- Fixed missing Chinese and Russian translation modules in APK, IPK and SDK-built web interface packages. The missing modules caused an HTTP 404 and prevented the interface from opening.
- Added checks for every application JavaScript module in the staged package and in both extracted package formats before publication.
- Matched the language selector height and top alignment to the adjacent theme controls, including native LuCI themes and responsive layouts.

This release includes the four interface languages and node list fixes introduced in 5.8.2-r2. Upgrade the luci-app-zirgozar package to resolve the missing language files.
